rows.en:
After that, before I knew it,
Sheryl had gone back to the Galaxy fleet.
rows.notes: Male narration, frd_she_009. Galaxy = the Macross Galaxy fleet.

rows.en:
Back at work as a singer, Sheryl showed
no sign of her time away,

and in the blink of an eye, she was
the Galactic Fairy once again...

Me, I went on with my ordinary life,
day in, day out,

and the two years Sheryl was here
felt like something out of a movie.
But strangely enough, it didn't get me down,
rows.notes: x2, both genders; continues in c13980.

rows.en:
and remembering it all made me feel
like I could give anything my best.

Maybe that was a spell cast
by the 'Galactic Fairy'...

Speaking of which, it turns out Sheryl's
next tour is bringing her to Frontier.

The whole ship is going wild over it,
and apparently tickets are really hard to get.

And in the middle of all that, though
I have no idea who they're from,
two tickets arrived for me...
Now, who should I go with...?
Come ooon!
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders; she is hurrying the player along.

rows.en:
Geez, I told you I'm tired.
Let me rest for a bit...

Oh, come on, hurry up!
If you dawdle, I'll leave you behind!

Affinity ending.
Filler for Sheryl (male).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's plate, translated literally like c12399. The Japanese says male although the occurrence is in the female-variant slot; kept as written.

rows.en:
Affinity ending.
Filler for Sheryl (female).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder, literal like c12399; says female although in the male slot; kept as written.

rows.en:
After that, before I knew it,
Sheryl-san had gone back to the Galaxy fleet.

Back at work as a singer, Sheryl-san showed
no sign of her time away,

Me, I went on with my ordinary life,
day in, day out,

and the two years Sheryl-san was here
felt like something out of a movie.

Maybe that was a spell cast
by the 'Galactic Fairy'...

Speaking of which, it turns out Sheryl-san's
next tour is bringing her to Frontier.

The whole ship is going wild over it,
and it seems tickets are really hard to get.

And in the middle of all that, though
I have no idea who they're from,
Now then, who should I go with...?

Geez, I'm tired.
Let's take a little break...

(Oh, it's Sheryl. It's a long shot,
but I'll try asking her.)
rows.notes: x16, male, frd_she_101-108; pattern as c06039.

rows.en: Oh? Is there something you want with me?

Well, I'll give you points for courage,
but unfortunately I'm busy today.
Well, you're welcome to ask me again sometime.
rows.notes: x22, Sheryl; in frd_she_102 the line sits under Nanase's name plate (script bug); the wording works for either.

rows.en: (Guess that was a bit of a stretch...)

(Oh, Sheryl-san... It's a long shot,
but I'll try asking her.)

Yes. Want to go to Nyan-Nyan with me
after this? I was just wondering...
rows.notes: Female; answers 'Is there something you want with me?' (hai). Male twin c04114.

rows.en: Well, unfortunately I'm a little busy today.
(I guess that was asking a lot...)

Hmm...
If you're going to invite me anyway,
I'd like you to pick somewhere more fun.

Yes. Want to go to the Observation Pier with me
after this? I was just wondering...

Hmm... If you were going to invite me anyway,
I'd have liked somewhere more fun.

The Macross Quarter...?
I have zero interest in a place like that!

Well, you're welcome to ask me again sometime.
Just think properly about where
you're inviting me first.

Yes. I was wondering if you'd want to go see
the Macross Quarter with me this weekend...

The Macross Quarter...?
I'm not interested in a place like that at all...

Folmo, hmm... It's not bad, and I am interested...
but I've kind of got plans this weekend...
you know?

Yes. I was wondering if you'd want to go
shopping at Folmo with me this weekend...

"199"... It's not bad, and I am interested...
but I've kind of got plans this weekend...
you know?
rows.notes: x4, Sheryl. Place name written as in c04137/c04138.

rows.en:
Yes. I was wondering if you'd want to go
to "199" with me this weekend...

The artificial island!?
Oh my, do you want to see me in a swimsuit?
It's not a bad idea, but... hmm...

Well, you're welcome to ask me again sometime.
Just leave the ulterior motives at home
when you do.

Yes. I was wondering if you'd want to go
to the artificial island with me this weekend...
rows.notes: Female; male twin c04142 has 'Artificial Island' capitalised, here lowercase per glossary.

rows.en:
The artificial island!?
Hmm... it's not a bad idea, but...
I've been a little busy lately...

Central Park... That doesn't really grab me.
I wish you'd invite me somewhere more fun...

Yes. I was wondering if you'd want to go to
Central Park or something with me this weekend...

The Battle Frontier...?
I have zero interest in a place like that!

Yes. I was wondering if you'd want to go see
the Battle Frontier or something with me
this weekend...

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl to the Observation Pier
or something...)

Hey, Sheryl. Wanna go to the Observation Pier
or something after this?

Oh, \p.
Well, that doesn't sound bad...
Hmm...!?
rows.notes: x6, Sheryl, male; she notices something (work call) at the end.

rows.en:
Sorry, I've got a little work after this...
Ask me again if you get the chance.

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl-san to the
Observation Pier or something.)

Oh, Sheryl-san.
Would you like to go to the Observation Pier
or something after this?

Oh, \p-chan.
Well, that doesn't sound bad...
Hmm...!?
Hm? What's wrong?
rows.notes: x16, female; same English as male twin c04166.

rows.en:
Okay. It's a little disappointing,
but it can't be helped.
(Well, I can always ask her again.)
